Research position overview

The Macquarie project develops graph-level mining methods for complex data environments. Research addresses challenges such as multiple data sources, low-quality data and interactions between graphs, aiming to produce both theoretical methods and empirical results.

Research Areas

  • Graph mining
  • Machine learning
  • Data science

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryAUD 40,900/year, indexed

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsInternational applicants; stipend and tuition offset; initial expression of interest required.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round15 December 2026
LocationAustralia

How to Apply

  1. Review the Macquarie project and confirm eligibility for its international scholarship route.
  2. Send the initial expression of interest to jia.wu@mq.edu.au, following the project’s document instructions.
  3. Complete the scholarship and admission stages requested by the host before 15 December 2026.

About Macquarie University

Macquarie offers doctoral research through its schools and research groups in Sydney. Its project scholarships support particular research topics, with applicants assessed for academic preparation, research fit and admission eligibility.
